0022600105.text: The Nets (0-1) are off to a slow start in the 2026-27 season, sitting 10th in the East and 4th in the Atlantic, 1 game back, after a loss in their first game, while the Cavaliers have not yet played a 2026-27 game. The teams have not met yet this season, and Brooklyn lost all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 106-102 at home on March 1, 2026. Brooklyn's Tyler Bilodeau is day-to-day with a shoulder injury and is a game-time decision, while Cleveland will be without Khalifa Diop (knee) and Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back), who are both out.
